svg.title: thiru.jac, an intro written in Jac
svg.desc: A Jac program with an Engineer node and an Intro walker. Running jac check prints "thiru.jac ok [100%]", and jac run prints: Hi, I'm Thiru, AI Engineer at Jaseci Labs. -> JacHammer -> JacCoder -> the Jac compiler

text.tspan: Hi, I'm Thiru, AI Engineer at Jaseci Labs.
